items.text: Among patients receiving chemotherapy in the breast and colorectal clinics from March 2026 to February 2027, what proportion of expected weekly symptom reports is completed over the first 12 weeks of treatment, and is completion lower in the week after an unanswered severe alert?
items.population: Adults receiving chemotherapy in the breast and colorectal clinics, March 2026 to February 2027
items.intervention: Unanswered severe alert in the previous week (exposure)

items.text: How do patients who stopped reporting, and the triage nurses who read alerts, explain stopping and alert handling?
items.population: Patients who stopped reporting before finishing chemotherapy; triage nurses
items.outcome: Reasons for stopping and ways alerts are handled

finer: Feasible with platform exports and one protected day a week; interesting to the rollout committee and nurses; novel locally; ethical under the approved evaluation; relevant because two clinics start in January 2027.
summary: One quantitative question on completion and alert response, one qualitative question on reasons.
